rv.q: Even if you're unaware of the playwright and his muse this is still essential theatre, and despite their faults it's all but impossible not to fall for both of these astonishing individuals.
Powell-Jones and her team make the strongest possible case. A must-see for all lovers of theatre, wit, and wincing put-downs.
This play is beautifully crafted by Stella Powell-Jones with edge, wit and precision.
Pickup feels perfectly cast as Campbell, capturing her fire and charisma.

cn.t: Critics find this adaptation of Shaw and Campbell's correspondence a witty, fascinating glimpse into their turbulent relationship, though some question whether their letters fully sustain theatrical drama.
